question: Why did the error rate go up on 03 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The auth feature flag change likely caused the error rate to increase.
why_chain: The auth feature flag was changed to 50% in eu-west, affecting service auth.
This change could have introduced a bug or incompatibility, leading to higher error rates.
The error rate for service auth increased significantly after the change.

contributing_factors.description: The upstream identity-db service failure contributed to the error rate increase.
why_chain: The upstream identity-db service returned HTTP 503 errors (service unavailable) after the feature flag change.
This failure caused retries and timeouts in the auth service.
The retries and timeouts led to an increase in error rate.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in request volume caused the error rate to rise.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume for service auth did not change significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in p95 latency caused the error rate to rise.
ruled_out.reason: The p95 latency for service auth increased, but the error rate did not decrease proportionally.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service auth rose from 0.39% to 5.06% (+1196%), with a change point at 2026-03-03T06:55:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service auth: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.06).
At the same time, request volume for service auth stayed about the same (1082 per 5 min before, 1303 per 5 min after, +20%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service auth rose (91 ms before, 162 ms after, +79%).
Changed auth feature flag new_ui_flow to 50% in eu-west (auth, eu-west; 2 min before the change; record R012)
Upstream identity-db returning HTTP 503 for auth (auth; 5 min after the change; record R014)
auth: ERROR upstream identity-db timeout after 3 retries (auth, ap-south; 1 min after the change; record R013)
auth: ERROR upstream identity-db timeout after 3 retries (auth, us-east; 7 min after the change; record R015)
auth: ERROR upstream identity-db timeout after 3 retries (auth, eu-west; 15 min after the change; record R016)

reasons: ✓ A change event (config_changes) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✗ 1 other change event(s) fit about as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
✗ Two or more changes fit equally well, so the cause cannot be confirmed.
missing_data: Details to tell the competing changes apart (e.g. a rollback test)

actions.action: Roll back the auth feature flag change to the previous value.
Monitor the identity-db service for any further failures and take corrective actions if necessary.
Review and test the identity-db service to ensure it is stable and reliable.
